title: From AGI to ASI
abstract: arXiv:2606.12683v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Over the last decade, building human-level artificial general intelligence has moved from far-fetched speculation to being a concrete next-decade target for many of the largest AI organisations. Achieving this goal would have profound and far-reaching impacts on human society, which raises many complex questions for the decade ahead. This report investigates how AI itself might continue to develop in a post-AGI world along the continuum of machine intelligence. The endpoint of this continuum, Universal AI, is theoretically well understood, which provides some formal grounding for the main focus of this report: the transition from human-level AGI to artificial general superintelligence, which can intuitively be understood as a system that is more intelligent and cognitively capable than large organisations of humans. After characterizing ASI, the report discusses four potential pathways from AGI to ASI: scaling AGI, AI paradigm shifts

translated_title: 从通用人工智能到超级人工智能
translated_abstract: 在过去十年中，构建人类水平的通用人工智能（AGI）已从遥不可及的猜想转变为主流研究目标。实现这一目标将对人类社会产生深远而广泛的影响，这也为未来十年提出了许多复杂的问题。本报告探讨了在AGI实现后的世界中，人工智能本身将如何沿着机器智能的连续谱继续发展。该连续谱的终点——通用智能——在理论上已被充分理解，这为本报告的核心议题提供了一定的形式化基础：即从人类水平的AGI向人工超级智能（ASI）的过渡，ASI可以直观地理解为一个在智力和认知能力上超越大型人类组织的系统。在刻画ASI的特征之后，报告讨论了从AGI到ASI的四种潜在路径：扩展AGI、AI范式转变等。
tldr: 本报告系统刻画了从人类水平的通用人工智能（AGI）向在智力与认知能力上超越大型人类组织的超级人工智能（ASI）过渡的过程，并探讨了后AGI时代机器智能沿连续谱发展的四种潜在路径。
en_tdlr: This report characterizes the transition from human-level AGI to artificial superintelligence (ASI)—a system more intelligent and cognitively capable than large organizations of humans—and discusses four potential pathways for AI development along the machine intelligence continuum in a post-AGI world.
